races.name: Mortal Bunny Rum Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Juggernaut
runners_data.note: Reliable prominent runner whose recent second-place finishes suggest he's in good heart under the consistent James Robottom partnership
runners_data.comment: Doesn't look that well treated despite recent placings but should give his running
runners_data.spotlight: Reliable type who has finished runner-up at Fontwell (2m1f, good) and Stratford (3m2f, good) this spring; he was beaten 7l and 9l in those races under James Robottom and he's off the same mark as last time.

runners_data.name: Red Rubio
runners_data.note: Point winner stepping up in trip which should suit his staying style, and his third on handicap debut suggests more to come
runners_data.comment: From off the pace he was an encouraging third on handicap debut; raised in distance
runners_data.spotlight: 3m point winner; from off the pace he was an encouraging third on handicap debut at Hereford (2m, good) and this longer trip looks sure to benefit him; considered.

runners_data.name: Aslukgoes
runners_data.note: Long absence of 168 days is concerning for a horse who has disappointed in two handicaps for current connections
runners_data.comment: Useful at best but quiet for current yard and softening ground would be a concern
runners_data.spotlight: Good bumper form (three wins, including Listed) and a novice hurdle winner (all on good); nowhere near that level in two handicaps for current yard and cheekpieces are now turned to; the prospect of softening ground is a further concern.

runners_data.name: October Hill
runners_data.note: Winless in 11 attempts under rules with recent form showing 15-length defeats, making her hard to recommend despite Pipe training
runners_data.comment: 0-11 under rules and has been beaten about 15l in her two handicaps
runners_data.spotlight: Ex-Irish mare who is 0-11 under rules and has been beaten about 15l in her two handicaps; unwise to rate her subsequent placed form in maidens as improvement; cheekpieces tried last time are removed.

runners_data.name: Lemon Leaf
runners_data.note: Course and distance winner last time who sets the pace but faces a 10lb penalty and potential stamina questions over this trip
runners_data.comment: Took a 10lb hit for recent C&D success but he looks progressive
runners_data.spotlight: They only jumped four hurdles when this lightly raced 6yo made a successful handicap debut over C&D, winning by just under 4l; took a 10lb hit for that but he looks progressive.

runners_data.name: Lion Of The Desert
runners_data.note: Back-to-back course winner whose hold-up style suits this longer trip, though the 5lb rise and soft ground pose questions
runners_data.comment: Back over this trip he's gone back-to-back in course handicaps; up 5lb for last time
runners_data.spotlight: Back over this trip he's gone back-to-back in course handicaps (good ground; placed on soft), last time nicely on top in the finish; up another 5lb but looks sure to be involved.

races.paceDynamic: Lemon Leaf is the only confirmed front runner and will set the pace without pressure from the flag. The five prominent runners (Juggernaut, Red Rubio, Aslukgoes, October Hill) plus hold-up horse Lion Of The Desert will track behind in a bunch. This creates a moderate, sustainable gallop that builds gradually over the 2m4f trip on testing soft ground. The lack of pace pressure strongly favours horses that can travel comfortably in behind and produce a sustained finish - benefiting prominent trackers and the hold-up horse over the lone leader.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Finish Wins
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays moderate throughout and turns into a stamina test
scenarios.body: Lemon Leaf sets reasonable fractions but gets worn down in the final half-mile as fresher horses with better finishing kicks reel him in. Lion Of The Desert and Red Rubio benefit most from the strong gallop over this longer trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Lemon Leaf gets an easy lead and quickens turning for home
scenarios.body: The pace-setter uses his course and distance win to advantage, kicking clear before the prominent runners can organize their challenges. His 29-day break keeps him fresh enough to resist late challengers on ground that suits.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners travels strongly and moves early
scenarios.body: Juggernaut or Red Rubio positions perfectly behind Lemon Leaf and strikes decisively after the last hurdle. The winner avoids the stamina-sapping front-running role while having enough pace to resist the hold-up horse's late charge.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the soft going and 2m4f trip finds out several runners
scenarios.body: Multiple horses fail to see out the trip effectively on the testing surface. Aslukgoes or October Hill, both struggling for form, manages to pick up the pieces despite moderate recent efforts.

watchPoints.text: Lion Of The Desert's jumping - any mistakes from the hold-up horse will end his chances of timing a late challenge
Red Rubio's early position - if he gets too keen tracking Lemon Leaf he may not see out the longer trip on soft ground
Lemon Leaf's jumping rhythm - the front runner needs clean jumps to maintain his advantage against the chasing pack
Aslukgoes showing ring rustiness - 168 days off means any early mistakes or keen going will compromise his stamina reserves
October Hill's effort level - her recent poor form means she needs to show significantly improved application to be competitive

races.name: Happy 1st Birthday Donnacha Fenelon Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Brenda Lady
runners_data.note: Unknown running style on hurdling debut, breeding suggests stamina but complete mystery how she'll handle obstacles
runners_data.comment: Appealing pedigree but this is a belated racecourse debut
runners_data.spotlight: Eleventh foal; sister to bumper/2m5f hurdle winner Far Sight, half-sister to five winners including Dare To Endeavour (useful 2m4f-3m chase), Holly James (bumper/2m hurdle) and Grand Enterprise (2m2f/3m hurdle); dam 2m-2m5f hurdle winner; appealing pedigree but this is a belated racecourse debut.

runners_data.name: The Flaggy Shore
runners_data.note: Front-running style with Listed race experience gives him clear tactical edge, 74 days off manageable for proven performer
runners_data.spotlight: Point winner who won a Warwick bumper by 7l and contested two Listed races since then, finishing second on the first occasion; promising recruit to hurdling.

runners_data.name: Fiskardo
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer returning with tongue-tie addition after Perth success, 26 days ideal gap but needs others to collapse
runners_data.comment: Bumper winner last month but others in here did have superior form in that scene
runners_data.spotlight: Back from a long absence to edge home in a good-ground bumper at Perth last month (first run in a tongue-tie); others in here did have superior form in that scene.

runners_data.name: Kenobi
runners_data.note: Hold-up style but chronic underperformer over hurdles, pulled up or tailed off record makes him hard to trust
runners_data.comment: Pulled up or tailed off in his three runs over hurdles and holds no appeal
runners_data.spotlight: Pulled up or tailed off in his three runs over hurdles and makes very little appeal.

runners_data.name: One Knight
runners_data.note: Prominent runner whose two bumper wins came with Johnstone-Baker aboard, disappointment last time offset by return to smaller field
runners_data.spotlight: Won his first two bumpers for this yard under Cameron Johnstone-Baker (good to soft/good) before disappointing in a Grade 2 at the Grand National meeting; could easily be up to this on his hurdling debut.

races.paceDynamic: The Flaggy Shore will dictate from the front with no genuine pace pressure, allowing David Noonan to control the tempo throughout. One Knight may track in second under Johnstone-Baker, while hold-up horses Fiskardo and Kenobi will need to be wound up from the back. With soft ground testing stamina and The Flaggy Shore free to bowl along uncontested, this sets up perfectly for the confirmed front-runner to exploit his tactical advantage. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and the lone pace-setter.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Flaggy Shore Controls All
scenarios.trigger: If The Flaggy Shore jumps cleanly and maintains his rhythm from the front
scenarios.body: Noonan can dictate ideal fractions on testing ground, making life difficult for closers who must pass tired legs. The class recruit's bumper form and tactical position prove decisive in a small field where pace is gold.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes crawling slow and suit closers perfectly
scenarios.body: Fiskardo's Perth win shows he retains ability after his break, and the tongue-tie addition could unlock improvement. Soft ground stamina test allows him to grind past tiring leaders in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Pounces
scenarios.trigger: If One Knight settles handily and Johnstone-Baker produces him with a well-timed challenge
scenarios.body: His two bumper wins for Lavelle show genuine ability, and tracking The Flaggy Shore gives him first crack at the leader. The soft ground suits his previous winning conditions perfectly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Shock Newcomer Debut
scenarios.trigger: If Brenda Lady shows immediate hurdling aptitude on debut over obstacles
scenarios.body: Her breeding suggests stamina and the yard knows her best, potentially catching more exposed rivals napping. However, this requires everything to fall perfectly for an unknown quantity.

watchPoints.text: Watch The Flaggy Shore's jumping fluency early - any mistakes will compromise his front-running advantage immediately
Monitor how quickly Fiskardo travels into contention - if he's still struggling turning in, the tongue-tie hasn't worked
Observe Brenda Lady's obstacle technique throughout - first-time hurdlers can surprise but schooling errors are costly
Check if One Knight settles properly tracking the pace - his Grade 2 flop suggests temperament concerns
Watch for any market support for the David Rees newcomer Brenda Lady - stable money could reveal hidden ability

races.name: Happy 1st Birthday Idris Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Green Asset
runners_data.note: Prominent runner whose Newton Abbot second suggests readiness for this trip extension and the soft going holds no concerns.
runners_data.comment: Improved second over 2m5f at Newton Abbot and he looks ready for this longer trip
runners_data.spotlight: An improved clear second over 2m5f at Newton Abbot last month and he looks ready for this longer trip; should run well.

runners_data.name: Blackacre
runners_data.note: Hold-up style faces tough task from poor draw and his visor experiment suggests connections are searching for improvement.
runners_data.comment: Two chase wins last August but hasn't looked well treated since then; 0-11 as a hurdler
runners_data.spotlight: In a new visor he won two 3m2f handicap chases at Newton Abbot last August; has looked too high in the weights since then and he's 0-11 as a hurdler; others preferred.

runners_data.name: Hard Stare
runners_data.note: Front-runner returning from 72-day break with poor hurdles record but may find this trip more suitable than previous efforts.
runners_data.comment: Yet to get anything going over hurdles and was beaten 25l on his handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Some promise in bumpers but has yet to get anything going over hurdles and was beaten 25l on his handicap debut at Taunton (3m, good; 6-1).

runners_data.name: Glenmuick
runners_data.note: Prominent racer in first-time cheekpieces but warning signs about his finishing effort over shorter trips at similar venues.
runners_data.comment: His first run at 3m and in cheekpieces when a rallying second here a month ago
runners_data.spotlight: His first run at 3m and in cheekpieces when a rallying second here a month ago (good); may well have more to offer.

runners_data.name: Poet's Muse
runners_data.note: Front-runner with encouraging Taunton second over course and distance who should relish the step back up to three miles.
runners_data.comment: First worthwhile run under rules when beaten a head on her handicap debut at Taunton
runners_data.spotlight: Point winner; first worthwhile run under rules when beaten a head on her handicap debut at Taunton (3m, good) and that's something to build on; went up 2lb and Paddy Hanlon takes off 5lb this afternoon, so she's weighted to have a say.

runners_data.name: Good Girl Rachel
runners_data.note: Prominent style compromised by fade tendency and poor recent form across shorter trips suggests stamina concerns.
runners_data.comment: This longer trip is probably a good move for her handicap debut; tries cheekpieces
runners_data.spotlight: Beaten 6l in one of her points; pretty much tailed off in her three maiden/novice hurdles (2m-2m3f) but this longer trip is probably a good move for her handicap debut; tries cheekpieces.

runners_data.name: Crest Of Valour
runners_data.note: Prominent runner making handicap debut with added tongue-tie after 83-day break but form figures offer little encouragement.
runners_data.comment: Quiet so far but now makes handicap debut with a tongue-tie added
runners_data.spotlight: It's been underwhelming stuff thus far but he's treated accordingly for this handicap debut and a tongue-tie is added; entitled to show more.

runners_data.name: Alderley Charlie
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with catastrophic recent form whose tongue-tie addition suggests desperation from connections seeking improvement.
runners_data.comment: Never took to fences and never counted on his return to hurdles at Exeter; opposable
runners_data.spotlight: Form figures of PFPP over fences and, with a tongue-tie added, he never counted on his return to hurdles at Exeter; opposable.

races.paceDynamic: Hard Stare and Poet's Muse will set the early pace in this soft ground stamina test, with Hard Stare likely to press from the front and Poet's Muse tracking close behind after her encouraging Taunton second. The sustained gallop over three miles on testing ground will expose the stamina-shy and create a searching pace throughout. Green Asset and Glenmuick should sit prominent early but may struggle to sustain their effort, while the hold-up horses face a tough task getting into contention. This race shape strongly favours the prominent runners who can travel well into the straight and have the stamina reserves to kick when it matters.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Poet's Muse Dominates Early
scenarios.trigger: If Poet's Muse takes control from Hard Stare and dictates terms from the front
scenarios.body: The improving mare can use her stamina advantage to grind down rivals in the testing conditions, making full use of her recent Taunton experience over the trip. Her front-running style perfectly suits the likely honest pace and soft ground combination.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Green Asset Times Run
scenarios.trigger: If Green Asset can sit close enough to the pace without overexerting on the testing ground
scenarios.body: His prominent style allows him to track the leaders before making his move turning for home, with his Newton Abbot form suggesting he's ready for this step up in trip. The soft going suits and his racing weight gives him every chance.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Glenmuick Finds More
scenarios.trigger: If the cheekpieces continue to help Glenmuick and he can overcome his finishing concerns
scenarios.body: His prominent racing style keeps him in touch early but his tendency to fade late on testing ground remains a major concern over this extended trip. The step up to three miles may simply expose his stamina limitations further.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Hard Stare Breakthrough
scenarios.trigger: If Hard Stare can finally translate his bumper promise over hurdles and see out the trip
scenarios.body: His front-running tactics could steal a march if the pace collapses, but his poor hurdles record and 72-day break make this unlikely. The soft going and extended trip represent major question marks for a horse yet to convince over obstacles.

watchPoints.text: Poet's Muse jumps fluently early and travels strongly into the straight as her front-running style could prove decisive.
Green Asset gets prominent position without fighting for it as any early struggle for position will compromise his chances significantly.
Hard Stare shows early pace from the break as any sluggish start would end his hopes immediately given his poor recent hurdles form.
Glenmuick travels kindly turning for home but watch for the finishing fade that has plagued him in recent outings over shorter trips.
The pace development through the first circuit as any slow early gallop would bring the hold-up horses like Blackacre into contention.

races.name: Francky Du Berlais Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Hell Hound
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with proven 3m form who won cosily at Southwell but faces a 6lb rise in handicap mark for this return after 49 days off.
runners_data.comment: Southwell winner; fair shout off 6lb higher but might not appreciate too much rain
runners_data.spotlight: Bumper/hurdle winner who won on only his second run over fences at Southwell (3m, good), cosily by 3l; good chance off 6lb higher but might not appreciate too much rain (good to soft would be acceptable).

runners_data.name: Axel Bleue
runners_data.note: Another prominent runner who showed promise in hurdles but disappointed badly in his last two handicap attempts, returning after 29 days with tongue tie applied.
runners_data.comment: Could appreciate returning to a handicap but current wellbeing is a bit of an issue
runners_data.spotlight: Point and dual bumper winner in 2025; runner-up in two 2m7f novice hurdles in October but pulled up on handicap debut the next month and again ran moderately on his return, albeit back in a novice.

runners_data.name: Loki's Mischief
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who scored impressively over course and distance just 15 days ago and meets Hell Hound on better terms this time around.
runners_data.comment: His second run over fences when doing it fairly comfortably here two weeks ago (2m5f)
runners_data.spotlight: Placed over hurdles; only his second run over fences when doing it fairly comfortably here two weeks ago (2m5f, good; fine on softer) and he promises to stay this far; every chance off a 6lb higher mark.

runners_data.name: Jack's Jury
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer carrying bottom weight who ran Hell Hound's conqueror Loki's Mischief close last time and benefits from 7lb better terms with that rival.
runners_data.comment: Under 4l behind Loki's Mischief over 2m5f here recently and 7lb better off with the winner
runners_data.spotlight: 1-13 over hurdles; didn't go unbacked on chase debut when beaten under 4l by Loki's Mischief over 2m5f here recently and he's 7lb better off with the winner; clear claims.

races.paceDynamic: Hell Hound and Axel Bleue will both go forward from the start with their prominent running styles, creating a measured pace over this stamina-testing 3m trip on soft ground. Neither is a tearaway leader, so they'll likely settle into a sustainable rhythm without burning each other up early. The two hold-up horses Loki's Mischief and Jack's Jury will track from behind, relying on finishing kicks. This controlled early tempo followed by a stamina test in the closing stages clearly favours the front-running/prominent brigade who can control their own destiny.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Hell Hound or Axel Bleue dictate a steady early pace without pressure
scenarios.body: The leader gets an easy time of it before others can mount challenges, allowing them to reserve energy for the final hill climb. Their tactical advantage of controlling the tempo becomes decisive on this stamina-sapping ground.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pair go too fast early or make jumping errors
scenarios.body: Loki's Mischief and Jack's Jury benefit from a strong pace that sets up their closing kicks perfectly. The recent course winner Loki's Mischief particularly profits from his proven ability to pick up the pieces late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hell Hound Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Hell Hound uses his class edge to control from the front throughout
scenarios.body: His superior rating and recent course-and-distance winning form allows him to dictate terms from start to finish. The 6lb rise in the weights proves manageable given his proven stamina and jumping ability over this trip.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Axel Bleue Bounce Back
scenarios.trigger: If Axel Bleue recaptures his early season hurdles form on his chase return
scenarios.body: His dual bumper wins this year show retained ability, and the step back up to 3m suits his stamina-laden pedigree better than shorter trips. Mickey Bowen's 2/25 14-day strike rate suggests the yard is in decent form.

watchPoints.text: Hell Hound's jumping under pressure given his prominent style could be exposed if the pace becomes searching over the final mile.
Axel Bleue's recent poor form over fences means any early jumping errors could effectively end his chances in this small field.
Loki's Mischief's quick turnaround of just 15 days since his course victory may test his recovery abilities on this testing ground.
Jack's Jury's trainer Barry John Murphy showing 0/8 record over the past 14 days suggests the yard may be out of form currently.
The soft ground conditions favour the proven mudlarks Hell Hound and Jack's Jury based on their similar-going records.

races.name: Adept GRP Cabinets Mares' Handicap Chase (ARC Summer Chase Series Qualifier)

runners_data.name: Bridget Mary
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with proven C&D form and recent success, ideally positioned for moderate pace scenario
runners_data.comment: Left clear here a month ago but she did hold every chance at the time; raised only 2lb
runners_data.spotlight: Went very close at Chepstow (2m7f) before gifted the race over C&D last month when left clear late on; she did hold every chance at the time anyway and has gone up only 2lb.

runners_data.name: Just A Memory
runners_data.note: Class performer returning from 117-day break, prominent style suits but fitness question remains
runners_data.comment: Has won over fences but no positives to take from her last three races
runners_data.spotlight: Narrowly won small-field 2m5f handicap chase for Tom Ellis last September but her next two runs (3m2f, hurdle/chase) were very disappointing, as was her stable debut in January (hurdling); no headgear this afternoon; a bit risky.

runners_data.name: O'Grady's Hill
runners_data.note: Sole leader will set modest fractions but poor recent form suggests vulnerable in finishing straight
runners_data.comment: Beaten between 15l and 58l in seven starts for this yard, six of those handicap chases
runners_data.spotlight: Beaten between 15l and 58l in seven starts for this yard, six of those handicap chases; the blinkers did nothing last time.

runners_data.name: Lynsey Larue
runners_data.note: Prominent runner fitted with tongue-tie for first time, dual point winner with scope for improvement
runners_data.comment: Second at Warwick before a lesser show at Ludlow; tongue-tie could make a difference
runners_data.spotlight: Dual point winner; it was only her fourth run over fences when second at Warwick (3m, soft) and she could rebound from her Ludlow run now fitted with a tongue-tie; hard to dismiss.

runners_data.name: Shesupincourt
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits race shape but mounting losing run and string of big defeats are concerning
runners_data.comment: Losing run is mounting up, as are a string of big defeats
runners_data.spotlight: Losing run is mounting up, as are a string of big defeats; has won over hurdles and fences but she needs to get back on track.

runners_data.name: Fox Wallace
runners_data.comment: Has lost her way badly since her win/place form over fences last summer
runners_data.spotlight: Has lost her way badly since her win/place form over fences last summer; cheekpieces tried last time are swiftly removed; couldn't trust.

runners_data.name: Miss Pearl
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner returning quickly from hurdles defeat, needs everything to fall right from the back
runners_data.comment: She finished well behind over hurdles last week after a layoff
runners_data.spotlight: Went close at Bangor early last year and was placed again next time; however, her form ran cold afterwards and she finished well behind over hurdles last week after a layoff.

races.paceDynamic: O'Grady's Hill and Fox Wallace are confirmed front runners, but Fox Wallace is a non-runner, leaving O'Grady's Hill as the sole leader. This creates a moderate pace scenario with prominent runners Bridget Mary, Just A Memory, Lynsey Larue, and Shesupincourt sitting close behind. The lack of genuine pace pressure means the race will develop into a staying test over the final mile, with runners coming under pressure from 3f out. This shape favors prominent runners with stamina who can track the modest gallop and have gears left for the finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Bridget Mary Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Bridget Mary can track O'Grady's Hill without being rushed early
scenarios.body: Her proven C&D form and recent gifted win shows she has the class edge in this field. The moderate gallop will suit her prominent style and she can assert from 2f out.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Pace Battle
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners engage in tactical positioning behind the leader
scenarios.body: The lack of genuine pace allows multiple horses to stay in contention turning in, creating a sprint finish. Just A Memory's class could tell but Lynsey Larue's tongue-tie addition might spark improvement.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Miss Pearl gets the perfect ride from the back and finds clear running late
scenarios.body: The moderate gallop sets up perfectly for a closer to pick off tired leaders. Her stamina at 3m could be decisive despite poor recent form.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Shock Result
scenarios.trigger: If the moderate pace collapses completely in the final half-mile
scenarios.body: Form horses fail to fire and an unfancied runner with hidden stamina reserves capitalizes on the tactical race. O'Grady's Hill could benefit from setting his own fractions.

watchPoints.text: O'Grady's Hill must be watched for market support despite poor form as the only confirmed leader
Just A Memory's fitness after 117-day layoff could be exposed if the pace quickens unexpectedly
Lynsey Larue's tongue-tie addition suggests connections expect improvement from her Ludlow disappointment
Miss Pearl running again after just 7 days suggests connections are trying to find her mark quickly
Bridget Mary's market position will indicate confidence after her fortunate but deserved recent C&D success

runners_data.name: Kates Choice

runners_data.spotlight: Bumper efforts were fairly promising but her hurdles runs less so; new trainer fits a hood for handicap debut on what's her first run since December; others safer.

runners_data.spotlight: 20-race maiden under both codes and did plenty wrong when pulled up last time at Warwick (2m5f); opposable.

runners_data.name: Forest Spirit

runners_data.name: Barafundle Bay
runners_data.note: Hold-up type making stable and handicap debut after 174-day absence, limited hurdling experience with poor finishing positions
runners_data.comment: Low-grade Flat winner in 2024; beaten 22l and 39l in her two runs over hurdles
runners_data.spotlight: Low-grade Flat winner in 2024; beaten 22l and 39l in her two runs over hurdles and makes stable/handicap debut after a lengthy break; may need the ground good or quicker.

runners_data.name: Mya Du Clos
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare stepping back from 3m trip that may not have suited, still seeking breakthrough performance over hurdles
runners_data.comment: Perhaps failed to stay 3m on her handicap debut but she still has plenty to prove
runners_data.spotlight: Quiet at about 2m over hurdles before going up to 3m on handicap debut at Southwell, a trip she might not have stayed; she's still got plenty to prove.

runners_data.name: Mystical Mabel
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with best recent form showing 5-length defeat at Fontwell, most progressive profile in the field

runners_data.spotlight: Her best result yet over hurdles when 5l off the winner in a Fontwell handicap (2m3f, good) last time; had no excuses from a prominent position but should be thereabouts with something similar.

races.paceDynamic: Miss Tiara is marked as NON-RUNNER, removing the only confirmed front runner from this field. This leaves no natural pace-setters among a field dominated by hold-up horses (6 of 8 remaining runners). La Belle Argentee as the sole prominent runner will likely inherit the lead by default, creating a crawling early pace with no pressure applied. The race will develop into a sprint finish from the final half-mile, heavily favouring horses that can quicken late and handle tactical races.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Crawling Pace Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If La Belle Argentee leads unchallenged creating a slow early gallop
scenarios.body: The race becomes a dash from 3 furlongs out where sharp horses with tactical speed excel. Late-running types like Mystical Mabel and Forest Spirit can unleash their finishing kicks from off the moderate pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Takes Control
scenarios.trigger: If La Belle Argentee dictates throughout and kicks clear approaching the last
scenarios.body: Her wind operation recovery and 38-day break could see her sustain the gallop better than expected. The hold-up brigade get caught flat-footed by her sustained drive to the line.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Early Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If La Belle Argentee fails to handle the lead role and the pace becomes stop-start
scenarios.body: Multiple horses get in each other's way as they all try to come with late runs simultaneously. The race becomes a lottery where positioning and luck matter more than ability.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Stamina Test Unfolds
scenarios.trigger: If the soft ground and 2m4f distance takes its toll despite the slow pace
scenarios.body: Even from a moderate gallop, the combination of testing conditions and trip finds out those lacking stamina. Horses with proven staying ability come to the fore in the final furlong.

watchPoints.text: Watch La Belle Argentee in the early stages - if she refuses to take up the running, this becomes a complete tactical mess
Watch for traffic problems in the home straight with so many hold-up horses needing room to challenge simultaneously
Watch Mystical Mabel's position turning for home - she needs to be within striking distance to unleash her superior finishing kick
Watch Forest Spirit's jumping early on - any mistakes will leave him too much ground to make up from his hold-up style
Watch the pace through the first mile - if it's genuinely slow, expect a bunched field and frantic finish
